sources.title: BALUCHISTAN iii. Baluchi Language and Literature
sources.locator: Language overview: Baluchi within the Western Iranian group; discussion of dialect geography including Eastern Hill Baluchi east of Quetta and the diversity of written/dialect forms.

sources.title: BALUCHISTAN i. Geography, History and Ethnography
sources.locator: Historical and ethnographic overview emphasizing the region's cultural and linguistic heterogeneity and cautioning against overly simple accounts of Baluch identity.

whoTheyAre.summary: The current PeopleGroups.org record identifies Eastern Baloch in Pakistan and ties the record to Eastern Balochi (bgp). Glottolog independently places Eastern Balochi in Pakistan, while Encyclopaedia Iranica situates Baluchi within the Western Iranian language group and stresses that Baluchistan is culturally and linguistically heterogeneous.

religionAndCommunity.summary: PeopleGroups.org reports an aggregate Sunni Islam label for this people-group-in-country record. That source label is useful mission-research context but cannot be generalized to every Eastern Baloch person's belief or practice.

profile.whyUnreachedIntro: The current unreached classification is explained only from PeopleGroups.org mission-status evidence. Ethnicity, regional history, language and religion are not treated as causes of spiritual status.

claims.text: The current PeopleGroups.org profile PG006346 identifies the people-group record as Eastern Baloch in Pakistan and lists Balochi, Eastern (bgp) as its primary language.
claims.interpretationNote: The public profile establishes PGID/name/country/language alignment; live PEID identity must still be re-fetched before publication.

claims.text: Glottolog identifies Eastern Balochi with glottocode east2304 and ISO 639-3 code bgp and lists Pakistan as its country.

Independent linguistic and ethnographic references place Baluchi varieties across a broad and internally diverse region; Encyclopaedia Iranica specifically warns that Baluchistan contains major cultural and linguistic discontinuities, so this candidate treats 'Eastern Baloch' as the source record's scoped identity rather than a uniform description of all Baluch communities.
claims.interpretationNote: This synthesis is intentionally a caution against overgeneralization, not a new ethnic taxonomy.

claims.text: The current PeopleGroups.org Eastern Baloch of Pakistan profile reports Sunni Islam as its aggregate primary-religion label.
claims.interpretationNote: This is a provider classification for PG006346, not a statement about every Eastern Baloch person's belief or practice.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org currently reports GSEC 1, less than 2% evangelical presence and no recent church-planting activity for PG006346, and presents the record as Unengaged and Unreached.
claims.interpretationNote: These are source-native mission-research fields for one people-group-in-country record, not a judgment about individuals.
